name: Smart Vertex Interpolation with Auxiliary Arrays
definition: A technique to avoid duplicate vertex calculation in Marching Cubes by computing vertex coordinates only the first time an active edge is considered, storing the index in auxiliary arrays to be reused by adjacent cells.
summary: Smart Vertex Interpolation with Auxiliary Arrays eliminates redundant calculations in Marching Cubes by storing computed vertex indices in auxiliary arrays for reuse, ensuring each vertex is calculated only once.
